name: tap
description: Performs a tap action at the specified screen coordinates (x, y pixels from top-left corner). Use this when you need to tap at a specific location that doesn't have a reliable element ID, or when working with canvas/game elements. Coordinates are absolute screen pixels, so they may vary across different device resolutions. Prefer findElement + clickElement when possible as it's more reliable across devices.

x.description: Horizontal coordinate in pixels from the left edge of the screen (0 = left edge)

y.description: Vertical coordinate in pixels from the top edge of the screen (0 = top edge)
